Remove the 28 day time limit from the unduly lenient sentence scheme for murder, I would like the Government to remove the 28-day time limit for applying to the lenient sentence scheme to have a sentence reviewed, for convictions of murder., Currently the families of murder victims have no recourse against an unduly lenient sentence, if they do not apply within 28 days.

I am campaigning for this change because my sister was murdered in 2013. We believe her killer meets the criteria for a whole life order but he was only given a minimum sentence of 35 years. We believe this is too low, and that we should have the right to apply to have this sentence reviewed.

Increase maintenance loans for university students, We think that student maintenance loans are highly unfair. We think the debt of parents/guardians including mortgage repayments, outstanding student loans, car payments etc should be considered in determining the maintenance loan given to a student., Some students (like me and my peers) are struggling to afford the cost of living at university. We feel that not enough is done to support us financially when embarking on higher education. We do not think that the minimum student loan is comparable to the price of rent for the majority of university students. Maintenance loans should be able to cover rent at a minimum as well as food and travel. We feel that the government should be doing more to relieve financial strain on students to allow them to focus on their studies.

Introduce 'Grow Your Own' Laws for Legal Medical Cannabis Patients (CBPM), We think patients prescribed 'CBPM' by a medical specialist should be allowed to maintain 3-6 flowering plants (with extra considerations for starting new seedlings). , 'GYO' registration database could be maintained via local council, notifying police of local medical grows – similar to Canadian setup.

There are 45,000 legal medical cannabis patients across the UK, prescribed primarily bud/flower or refined oil extracts. Some patients face severe financial difficulty affording their prescription.
 
Many patients are unable to work, and are forced to turn to cheaper illicit sources due to affordability. "Grow Your Own" is available to cannabis patients in many other countries for this very reason, and we think must also be considered in the UK via a change to Home Office licensing/scheduling.

Introduce a low interest deposit loan to help all first time buyers, We think there is a housing crisis in this country and there are millions of young, working people who are unable to afford the most basic of life essentials - a home. We think the government needs to implement a proper scheme to support these people in the form of a low interest deposit loan., We think it is fundamentally wrong that the age of first-time buyers in the UK is now in the mid 30s. We believe these are individuals who work incredibly hard and still cannot afford a home, against a backdrop of regulations that allow substantial rental-only private developments, or similar such business ventures that we think exploit people who need housing but cannot afford to buy. We think it’s time for the government to take urgent, radical action to help these people secure a stable future.

Ban High-Silica Engineered Stone Worktops., We want high-silica engineered stone worktops banned due to the risk of silicosis resulting from silica dust particles. This stone is a common product in the market in the UK. Engineered stone is banned in Australia., Silica is naturally occurring in stone however some say engineered worktops can be 97% silica. While some UK stonemasons may be confident that they have the strongest health and safety measures in place to protect their team, we believe the risk of this material is not necessary when there are alternatives on the market.
Engineered stone is a large market in the UK and we urge the UK government to ban the sale of this product.

Make it a legal requirement for individuals to report child sexual abuse, The previous government proposed making it a mandatory duty for those working or volunteering with children to report child sexual abuse. We would like the Government to make it a legal requirement for all individuals to report child sexual abuse., We believe that this will help protect vulnerable innocent children from child sex abusers and those who enable or actively protect them, by introducing requirements for everyone to report child sexual abuse.

Fund more counselling services specific to victims of sexual violence, I want the government to fund more counselling services for those suffering with PTSD or other complications following a sexual assault., Leaving victims to get through life alone following a sexual assault is not okay. Once people walk out of that court room they can be left to suffer in silence and enough is enough. PTSD is very difficult, and it is extremely unpredictable.

Enact measures to combat knife crime, Establish a violence reduction unit like the Scottish Government did to minimise knife crime., Introduce a mandatory 5 year sentence for carrying knives.

Increase stop & search powers.

Because we believe knife crime is totally out of control. The VRU is what Scotland has done to combat that.

Review the child maintenance service, Review the child maintenance service., Review how the child maintenance service is run. We think the child maintenance service makes it very difficult for paying parents to work, due to high calculations and unexpected arrears. Some parents may refuse to go into direct pay because of concerns about the system. Some parents feel forced to stay on benefits, as they may not be able to afford to pay the arrears within 2 years, and think the monthly payments if they were to work would be unaffordable.

Scrap student loan interest rates in England, I would like the government to abolish the interest rate on student loans, or stop universities from charging tuition fees at all. , I do not think student loans, including the interest that is paid on them, is explained well enough to students at school before they apply to enter higher education. I believe the high interest rate on student loans is having a real impact on working people's take home pay.

Use diplomatic and trade influence to stop hot branding cattle around the world, I want the government to use its diplomatic and trading influence to try to persuade other countries to stop the cruel practice of hot branding cattle around the world.,

Stop businesses from making staff use annual leave at Christmas, The government should ban companies from making staff use their annual leave to cover holiday periods when the business is closed. Or alternatively they should increase the legal minimum holiday allowance to cover Christmas., Some companies that only provide the minimum holiday allowance of 20 days (plus bank holidays) will close at Christmas, leaving their staff as little as 15 days to use. We believe this shouldn’t be allowed. We think that there are people with religious views, or have no family and would rather work, or who simply don't like Christmas who have to sacrifice their annual leave. We believe that if companies chose to close for maintenance they wouldn't make their staff use leave, so why at Christmas?

Stop child sex offenders from joining public court cases on child sex abuse, To stop convicted child sex abusers from going into the public gallery at court in another case of child sexual abuse and listening to all the evidence and descriptions of child sexual abuse/ assault.,

Review powers of Child Maintenance Service regarding concealed income , We think there should be a review into how the Child Maintenance Service can tackle the issue of non-paying parents who are avoiding their responsibilities by working cash in hand., We think current CMS powers are insufficient to tackle this.

Ban overseas companies posing as UK companies & offering misleading products., I think there are increasing numbers of companies posing as UK based companies which are in fact based overseas. I think this should not be allowed and there needs to be an investigation into this malpractice and it needs to be banned. I think people are being scammed out of their hard earned money., I have fallen victim on several times this year to believing I was buying high quality products from UK companies when in fact they were overseas. In many cases products have not arrived or have been poor quality. I believe it is fine to order from overseas if you know who the overseas company is and shipping process described accurately but when these companies deliberately shown on their website that they are UK based, I think this is fraudulent and action needs to be taken.

Guarantee all current County Council Elections be held on 1st May 2025, To ensure all current and planned council elections proceed as expected on the 1st May 2025 and for devolution to be delayed until such elections have taken place, It is undemocratic and against the will of the people.

Ensure that student nurses are paid for their placement hours, We want the government to ensure that student nurses are paid for their placement hours. With the rise in living cost, even with the training grant and maintenance loans, we feel it is increasingly hard for student nurses to live., Student nurses are allowed to work for 48 hours a week including their placement hours for safety reasons. If nurses work 37.5 hours a week at their placements, that only leaves 10.5 hours a week to find paid work.
 
As a student nurse, living on my own and estranged from family, with the rise in living costs, I have found studying increasingly harder throughout each year. This has been to the point where I have had a small mental breakdown due to stress and exhaustion.
 
I know many other student who debate during every placement whether they should drop out due to financial difficulties.
 
We believe if the government wants to stop losing student nurses throughout their course, this is a major factor that needs looking into.

Democracy is under threat
Govt must proceed with  all local elections May 2025, The first sign of any democracy is free and fair elections...closely followed by freedom of speech.

The country is already feeling that freedom of speech is being severely curtailed so we cannot allow elections themselves to become playthings based on party expediency or ideological preference., Ensure that the long planned Local Elections planned for May 2025 go ahead in full.

The only reason to stop these in the past have been extreme events such as COVID and Foot and mouth.

This is not the case and it's unfathomable that local people will have to suffer maybe poor local councillors or authorities for years longer than would have been.

It's outrages and one step away president from putting back general elections to suit.

Subject the deployment of any non-UK nuclear weapons in the UK to a referendum, We call on the Government to make any deployment of non-UK nuclear weapons, or other weapons of mass destruction, in the UK to be subject to the sovereign will of the British public by way of a referendum., We do not believe that British people should face any risks caused by overseas wars and acts of aggression that we have no control over.

Outlaw marriages of couples with over 10 years age gap, where one is under 25, I think Parliament should ban marriages between couples with age gaps of more than 10 years. Sometimes there are great age differences between husband and wife in marriage. In cases of more than 10 years difference, I think the younger one should be at least 25., I believe that in cases where there is a huge age gap, a vulnerable younger partner could be at risk. Whilst forced marriage is illegal, there can still be huge family pressure to marry, especially for financial gain. This could give women in such situations, greater protection.

Keep Local Government LOCAL. Stop plans for county scale unitary authorities., We oppose government plans to create large unitary authorities which we think will be remote from and out of touch with those they serve., We think the "so called" devolution plans actually represent greater centralisation of local government.
The proposed devolution plans centralise current local government powers into larger authorities, in return for returning a small number of powers, responsibilities and income streams previously held by local government and taken by Whitehall in previous changes to local government. We think Whitehall should return that money and those powers to councils without imposing what we see as unwanted centralisation.

Transfer all child sex offenders and child murderers overseas, The Government should seek an agreement to transfer all prisoners serving sentences for child sexual abuse or murder of a child to serve their sentence overseas., I believe this would help reduce overcrowding, staff shortages and funding cuts. I believe it would be a remedy that should kill two with one stone as it would empty prison cells and should be of substantial financial benefit considering our prisons are currently operating at a cost of above fifty thousand United Kingdom pounds per prisoner per year.

Make income threshold for student loan repayments £60,000 and charge no interest, We propose the following change: Base repayments above £60,000 income are solely on the capital loan balance, charging no interest, allowing faster debt repayment and saving people that graduated after 1998 thousands., In 1998, the government introduced interest on student loans repayments. Before this, student loans were interest-free in real terms. For a graduate in 2022, the average student debt is £44,940, with interest accruing from the moment the loan is issued. Currently, most graduates are on Plan 2, where repayments begin once they earn above £27,295 per year. Above this threshold, a fixed percentage of income is deducted to repay the loan. However, there is no cap on the interest.

Confirm which month the next General Election will take place in, The Prime Minister recently confirmed that the General Election would take place at some point in 2024., We would like to know as soon as possible, which month the General Election will take place in. It could be scheduled in advance now, just as annual local elections are.

We would like clarity regarding the date of the General Election, and believe there is no good reason not to set a date now, both from the point of view of voters and those who govern the country.

Confirming the date now would put a stop to the endless media speculation regarding when the GE will occur.

Compulsory annual safety inspections on roads throughout England , Make it compulsory that all local authorities who are responsible for the maintenance & safety of public roads have those roads independently assessed on an annual basis in order to ensure that they are fit, and more importantly, safe, to be used by the public., Most vehicles have to pass an annual MOT in order to ensure that they are safe to be used on public roads, however, are those public roads in themselves safe to be used?
 
I think that many roads throughout this country are not fit for purpose, or safe for people to use without the risk of causing damage to their vehicles and/or injury to themselves or others.
 
It should be compulsory, just like the MOT, that roads are checked independently on an annual basis to ensure that they are safe.

Require cameras in all school classrooms and give parents access, The Government should require all schools to install live cameras in all school classrooms and give parents access so they can see their children at any time. Not only could this prevent any child sexual offenders but can also provide evidence for any allegations of abuse to teachers or children. , There have been too many cases of child sexual offenders in schools. We are concerned that many are not being caught and locked up due to a lack of evidence. Installing cameras in all classrooms could limit allegations and also help parents understand their children's behaviour during school hours and work with the school to help the child.

Ban the sale and importation of Zombie-style knives in the UK, I would like the Government to immediately ban the sale and importation of zombie-style knives. There are so many websites that are freely selling these and it needs to change., I am a former prisoner who now helps educate young people on the risks of drugs in the community and knife crime. I am from the city of Bristol but live now in Swindon and believe the level of knife violence is reaching epidemic levels. I have lost friends to this and if I can do one thing it would be to finally rid out streets of these highly dangerous weapons.

Increase the minimum sentence for illegal possession of a knife to 20 years, We want anyone found carrying a knife, without very good reason, to be automatically given a 20-year prison sentence as a minimum., Too many people are needlessly being stabbed. There is almost never a good reason to carry a knife in public but many feel they can carry, and use, knives without the fear of appropriate punishment.
 
Make the punishment so strong that people will stop carrying and using knives.

Introduce mandatory minimum sentences for possession of a knife, I want to see mandatory 12-month prison sentences for first time offenders, increasing for repeat offenders, alongside a mandatory 6-month knife awareness course for rehabilitation in the community., My son Harley Barfield, a vibrant 16-year-old boy, was stabbed 12 times in a planned attack in Haverhill, Suffolk on 9th January 2023. He lost his fight for life on 11th January 2023.
 
He was attacked in broad daylight, in front of many children that just finished school. The weapon? An everyday kitchen knife.
 
We need to change this now! We are calling on the Government to introduce new legislation that will impose mandatory sentences for anyone found carrying knives unlawfully.

Ban knives and increase minimum sentences for certain offences, We believe knife crime is out of control and current minimum sentences are token gestures and never going to change anything. , The answer is simple, ban knives & increase minimum sentences to 10 years for possession with intent and 20 years for using a knife, and a whole life sentence for taking a life.

So far nothing has really had any significant impact on deterring people from carrying or using a knife and we have to adopt a zero tolerance approach so anyone even considering carrying a knife knows they risk an automatic 10 years in prison just for possession with intent, 20 years for using a knife and a whole life sentence for taking a life. We see knife crime almost everyday, lives are taken too soon all the time and something has to be done. No more half measures or token gestures, Zero Tolerance.

Make CMS payable until the age of 20 for any child in any higher education, Make child maintenance payable to any child up to age of 20 in higher education so they receive financial support from both parents. One parent should not be given a choice to walk away from all financial responsibility, leaving the other parent to support the child alone., When parents are together they can support their child through education together, including university. CMS should continue to support anyone over the age of 18 up to the age of 20 in any form of higher education, including university. The maximum student maintenance loan isn’t always enough to cover the cost of accommodation and the cost of living. The higher earner gets away with not paying anything if they choose not to and the lower earner can end up even worse off trying to support their child.

Make payments on account optional for the self employed, Currently the self employed are expected to pay 50% of the next years tax bill based on the previous year tax. Self employed people don’t earn a fixed amount therefore the payments on account is needed to pay bills., Make POA optional. Give us the choice to pay it. I always put money aside for my tax bill but have a quiet start to the year generally so I need the money that HMRC are demanding. I feel the HMRC are getting an interest free loan from the self employed.

Increase sentences for child sexual abuse/grooming and expand disclosure scheme, We want the Government to increase sentences for people who commit child sexual offences or grooming offences, and legislate to expand the child sex offender disclosure scheme so anyone can find out if a child sex offender is living within a mile of their home., We believe offences involving children in this country are out of control and that the criminal justice system is not doing enough to tackle this. Sexual abuse can cause life long damage to victims. It is time to hold these people more accountable and give the public the right to know if an offender lives close to them and their child.

Ban the production and sale of pointed knives, We want the Government to make it illegal to produce or sell pointed knives, to help prevent knife crime., So many innocent life lost because of knife crime. We believe there is no need for a knife to have a pointed end. Knives do so much harm.
 
Even in the kitchen the pointed end of the knife is rarely used. But most kitchen knives have a pointed end.
 
So many innocent life lost due to penetrating injury by the pointed end of a knife, which can easily cause potentially fatal injuries to arteries and organs.
 
That's why I think there is no need for pointed knives.

Introduce mandatory life sentences for carrying a knife or other bladed weapon, This is very simple, we want anyone caught carrying a knife or other bladed weapon in public without proper reason to be jailed for life. No exceptions, no bail or parole., Knife crime is getting out of hand and we believe police forces don't have the powers or resources to tackle the rise in knife crime. Let's give the criminal a deterrent that will make them think twice, and if they still decide to carry a knife then they should be taken off the streets.

Offer low- or no-interest Government loans to all UK taxpayers, Create a Government loan scheme which offers all taxpayers access to low-interest or interest-free loans, repaid through a higher payment of tax over a period of so many months until the loan is repaid., Allow taxpayers to have access to Government loans, regardless of credit history. All taxpayers should be entitled. People who pay tax are the ones that keep this country running. I personally think that during the cost of living crisis the Government have been quick to allocate funds to issues and agendas that the general public have no interest in and do not benefit from. We ask the Government in this time of need to allow all who pay tax access to low- or no-interest loans, deductible through income tax.

Change the nursing degree financial strategy, Currently nurses have to complete  2300 hours of unpaid work during their 3 years of training and pay student loans and finance to gain a nursing degree of up to £60k. Student nurses should not have to complete all these hours without getting paid whilst also taking out student loans., Police and fire officers do not have to get £60k in debt for their training but yet nurses do and also work 2300 hours for free but again nurses do. Doesn’t make sense! Nurses are penalised massively for wanting to be a nurse. Nursing needs to be revised and students should be paid!

Implement the planned MOD's New Accommodation Offer, which is due in March 2024, Continue with the proposed New Accommodation Offer, due for implementation in March 2024. We think it is an effective policy that would improve the lives of serving personnel, regardless of rank. Make the MOD an inclusive place to work, ensuring equality of living standards regardless of rank., We think that many serving personnel and their families would benefit from the planned policy. We also think that removing or delaying it could have a devastating effect on already strained family lives and place unnecessary limits on personnel's living conditions. Military personnel are suffering loss of experienced workforce and delaying this could impact personnel retention, across all ranks and ratings. We think that rank should not be dictating personnel standards of living.

Ban High-Silica Engineered Stone Worktops, We want high-silica engineered stone worktops banned due to the risk of silicosis resulting from silica dust particles when improperly cut. This stone is a common product in the market in the UK. Engineered stone will be banned in most parts of Australia., Silica is naturally occurring in stone however some engineered worktops can be 97% silica. While UK stonemasons may be confident that they have the strongest health and safety measures in place to protect their team, we believe the risk of this material is not necessary when there are alternatives on the market.

Engineered stone is a large market in the UK and we urge the UK government to ban the sale of this product.

Take action to increase support for people with allergies, We want the Government to increase education in schools on allergies, provide funding for schools, restaurants, hotels, etc to have emergency epipens, and provide funding for additional support through the NHS for people with allergies, including for advice and support from dietitians., Paying for epipens in schools, restaurants, hotels, etc, and increased NHS support for people with allergies, will cost money, put could help save so many lives.

Help decrease the overall UK crime rate, Introduce a formal request for the implementation of a protocol mandating the stopping and searching of individuals donning balaclavas while on public streets., I would like the government or parliament help to assist the fast evolving criminal activity across the United Kingdom. Those wearing balaclavas have no reason to wear a balaclava unless potentially being involved in criminal activity, such as murders, robberies, trafficking etc

Make it a legal requirement for registered sex offenders to notify neighbours, We want every single convicted sex offender to be required to notify all neighbours living on their road that they are a registered sex offender. Make it a legal requirement to help protect young children from being put at risk of abuse!, Too many children experience this horrendous abuse and it needs to stop! We need to protect our children from convicted sex offenders and ensure we do everything we can to prevent innocent minors being exposed to traumatic which is life damaging!

Impose a five-year minimum sentence for carrying knives, I want the Government to impose a 5-year minimum sentence for all those found to illegally carry a knife. There is more to be done to combat knife crime, but I want the Government to start here.,

Require 30-year minimum prison term for premeditated murder regardless of age, Change the law to ensure younger people face more serious repercussions for a prosecution for premeditated murder. We want a statutory minimum of 30 years, no matter the age., Children are killing children and many are able to start a new life after 12 years, but what about the family of the murdered victim - they can't just start their life again. I believe more strict sentences would make perpetrators think twice about planning to murder innocent people, including children.

Remove the 28-day time limit from the unduly lenient sentence scheme for murder, I would like the Government to remove or amend the 28-day time limit for applying to the lenient sentence scheme to have a sentence reviewed, for convictions of murder., Currently the families of murder victims have no recourse against an unduly lenient sentence if they do not apply within 28 days. I am campaigning for this change because 28 days is not long enough when a family is grieving. My sister was murdered in 2013, we believe her killer meets the criteria for a whole life order but he was only given a minimum sentence of 35 years. We believe this is too low, and that we should have the right to apply to have this sentence reviewed.

Extend planned laws on reporting child sexual abuse to everyone, The Government said it will create a legal requirement for certain professionals to report child sexual abuse and that anyone who actively protects child sexual abusers could go to prison for 7 years. We believe this should be expanded to all members of the public., We believe this will help protect vulnerable innocent children from child sex abusers and those who enable or actively protect them, by introducing requirements for everyone to report child sexual abuse, and introducing custodial sentences for people who cover up for or protects the abuser.

Include a morality clause in all Government contracts
, Morality clauses require a prospective individual or organisation to adhere to a certain behavioural standard. Over the years there have been numerous reports public funds being directed to individuals or companies that we believe do not serve the public’s best interest.,

Allow prescribing of drugs to induce death for those in coma on end of life care, We want medical professionals to be able to prescribe life-limiting medication, which induces death, to patients on end of life care (sometimes called the end of life pathway) who have been put into an induced coma because life can no longer be supported. , Where a patient on end of life care is placed in an induced coma with no supporting nutrition, we believe allowing the prescription of life-limiting medication can provide a more humane treatment to the alternative of death resulting from starvation. We believe this should be allowed in these circumstances.
 
We believe planned loss of life prescribed and administered by medical professionals will reduce distress to patients and relatives, and allow palliative care services to give support over a shorter period and allow more positive direction/expectations to relatives.

Introduce 'Grow Your Own' Laws for Legal Medical Cannabis Patients, Allow patients that are prescribed cannabis to grow their own cannabis at home with a restriction of 6 plants per household. This is to assist people with financial difficulty who may not be able to afford a private prescription., We believe patients prescribed by a medical specialist should be allowed to maintain 3-6 flowering plants (with extra considerations for starting new seedlings.) A registration database could be maintained for grow your own patients
 
It has been estimated that there are around 25-30,000 legal medical cannabis patients across the UK. Patients can face severe financial difficulty affording their prescription.
 
"Grow Your Own" is available to cannabis patients in many other countries.

Require lifetime on sex offenders register for any sexual offence, We want anyone found guilty of a sexual offence, whether in the past or future, to be automatically placed on the sex offenders register for life., Change the law to replace existing rules for the sex offenders register so that anyone found guilty of a sexual offence is automatically placed on the sex offenders register, to help ensure safety for our community and prevent innocent victims falling foul of these criminals when some only have so many years on the register currently. We believe it should be for life for all sex offenders, and that this would be better justice for victims.

Remove benefit reassessments for people with degenerative physical conditions, We want the DWP to remove the need for individuals to have their benefit claims (such as Personal Independence Payment) reassessed where the individual suffers from life-limiting degenerative physical health conditions in which there will never be an improvement during their lives., I have been to tribunal court twice to have my PIP re-awarded even though I have a genetic degenerative disease which limits my life and will never improve but only get worse.

Require family court proceedings initiated by public services be held in public, We believe proceedings in the family courts that are initiated by public services should be held in public., We are concerned that the lives of families and children are being destroyed, causing irreversible damage. We believe that in too many cases bias and malpractice influences these proceedings, and that making proceedings public could help address this.

Abolish means testing for student maintenance loans for higher education, Students can apply for a full tuition fee loan for university - it is not means tested. The maintenance loan should be the same, students should be able to apply for the amount they feel they would need. Penalising children of high income parents is not fair. They are not dependents at 18., The cost of living accommodation at university can be extortionate. The minimum maintenance loan often does not cover the full costs. Students who come from low income families are able to receive a higher maintenance grant. Students whose parents earn more than a certain amount have to take the minimum grant - they cannot apply for more - this is unfair. Students should be given the choice. They should be able to take informed decisions, with parental advice, they are adults.

Mandate national service for carrying a knife, with an annual knife amnesty, We want anyone who is found guilty of illegal possession of a knife to be sentenced to national service. We also want an annual knife amnesty on 26 April, where people can give up illegal knives., Too many people, including young adults, are committing knife crime offences, including murder, having previously been charged with other knife crime offences.
 
We believe national service could help ensure offenders are rehabilitated, and tackle high rates of knife crime.
Require DNA tests to prove parentage for all child maintenance claims, We believe that DNA tests should be required before people can be liable for child maintenance claims.,

Ban carrying all knives regardless of length in public and increase sentences, We want the Government to change the laws surrounding knifes. It is currently legal to have a knife of 3 inches that folds. This can still be a deadly weapon. We want carrying a knife, of any length, in public to be illegal, and sentences for illegal possession of a knife to be increased., After the death of my 18 year old son Cameron we believe it is increasingly clear that there are massive flaws in the laws surrounding knife crime. Knife crime offences are increasing and we believe not enough is being done to deter people from carrying, and that the sentences given do not reflect the value of human life that is lost almost daily due to knife crime. It is my hope that enough people can get behind this and we can collectively bring about a change to give justice to families like mine who have suffered an immeasurable loss, and to also try and prevent it happening to others.

Make the sex offenders list public, I want the Government to make the sex offenders list a public record, where anyone can obtain information via a search engine, about whom is on the sex offenders list in their area. These records are currently private and closed to the public., We don't think people should have to make a request to the police for information about whether someone is a sex offender. We think making the sex offenders register public is an essential requirement for the protection of our children within our communities, and could help stop crimes being committed. This could not only help protect our children but also show the full identity of those who have been placed on the offenders list due to the disgusting crimes they have committed.

Restrict Veteran cards to those who pass basic training and serve with a unit, Stop the issue of Veteran ID cards and badges to those who don't complete basic training and go on to serve within a unit, unless they are medically discharged. , Introduce a qualifying criteria for veterans ID and a badge based on passing training and serving time in a service role. These should not be given to people who do not pass basic training and go on to serve within a unit. I think that issuing veteran cards and badges to those who serve as little as one day makes a mockery of those who completed their training and went on to serve their country.

Arming the UK police with firearms., Arm/arming the police with firearms.

To grant the power to use a firearm when criminals are in possession of serious weapons (firearms, knives etc.) and intends to use it or has already used it against a member of the public., The public needs to feel secure and know that the police are capable of protecting them, that the police are given all the tools and powers they need to disarm and deprive the dominance of attackers and prevent further crime. To avoid tragedies and murders.
